title: Repeated Game With Incomplete Information
body_html:
Repeated Game With Incomplete Information

In the one-sided zero-sum model treated by MFoGT, a state $k$ is drawn from a prior $p\in\Delta(K)$. Player 1 observes $k$, player 2 observes only the prior, and the corresponding zero-sum stage game is repeated.

Actions are observed after each stage, so player 1's actions may both affect payoffs and reveal information about the state.

References

  • [MFoGT, Chapter 8, Section 8.6.3] Laraki, Renault, and Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory, references/MathFoundationsGameTheory.pdf. Repeated zero-sum games with lack of information on one side.
